caesar-besieged-alexandria.description: A man in a red cloak and armour stands at the lower right, arm outstretched toward a line of helmeted soldiers with oval shields behind a barricade of broken timber and rubble. Behind them, colonnaded stone buildings stand under a smoky dark sky, and in the background ships burn in a harbour with bright flames. The painting is edge to edge, with no visible text, frame or border.

rome-annexes-egypt.description: A young man in a red cloak and metal chest armour stands on stone steps before a massive Egyptian temple wall covered in carved reliefs, pointing with one arm. Beside him, Roman legionaries in helmets and scale or mail armour hold shields, and one carries a tall golden eagle standard. To the left, galley ships sit moored at a dark, stormy waterfront, with shirtless men working in the foreground. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

portugal-captures-ceuta.description: Armoured men in plate and mail wade out of wooden boats and rush toward a stone fortress with an arched wooden gate, torches burning on the walls. Two sailing ships with square and lateen sails sit in stormy grey water behind them, and a soldier climbs a ladder against the wall. Defenders in white head cloths throw things from the battlements. Painted in a dark oil style, no visible text, the image runs edge to edge.

da-gama-sails-round-africa.description: A painted scene of a sailing ship's deck with crew hauling ropes, a large cream sail with a red cross, a stormy sea, dark rocky cliffs on the right, and two other ships in the background. Dress and rigging look like the 15th-century era. No visible text, frame or border. The painting is full bleed.

alcacer-quibir-sebastian-dies.description: A knight in plate armour with a red sash and gold trim rides a rearing black horse, raising a sword overhead and shouting. Behind him, turbaned riders in white and tan robes wield curved swords amid smoke and red banners. On the left a musketeer in red trousers and a steel helmet carries a long gun. Dark stormy sky over a dusty plain; no visible text, no frame, no blood.

mungo-park-reaches-niger.description: A man in a torn blue coat and battered top hat kneels on a muddy riverbank, drinking from cupped hands. Behind him a wide river holds several wooden canoes carrying robed people and bundles, and a mud-brick town with a domed mosque and minarets sits on the far shore under a stormy, golden-lit sky. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

boers-win-blood-river.description: A painted scene of bearded men in slouch hats and worn coats firing long rifles from behind white-topped ox-wagons and a thorn-bush barricade. Across the grass, a massed line of warriors with oval shields runs forward, and a river bends through the flat landscape under a stormy sky. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge, with wagon wheels in the foreground.

livingstone-sees-victoria-falls.description: A man in a dark peaked cap and dark, worn coat lies flat on a mossy rock ledge at the lip of a huge waterfall, peering over the edge. Behind him, several Black men in a dugout canoe paddle through fast, churning water toward the falls, with a second canoe behind. The setting is mist-filled cliffs and dense tropical trees. The clothing and canoes suggest the 19th century. I see no visible text, no frame or border, and nothing graphic.

british-storm-magdala.description: A painted battle scene on a steep rocky mountain path. British-style soldiers in white pith helmets and red tunics fire rifles and climb toward a stone fortification with a large wooden gate. Several war elephants are present: one hauls a mounted artillery piece, and others carry riders. Smoke drifts across the slope under a stormy sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible border, text, or signature, and there is no gore.

italy-invades-libya.reason: The central sailor's cap band has painted lettering (a word like 'TORPEDO'). Repaint the cap with a plain, blank band.
italy-invades-libya.description: Oil painting of sailors in dark caps and soldiers in pith helmets crowding rowing boats and leaping onto a stone quay beneath a massive old fortress. Steel warships with smoking funnels lie offshore, and a domed mosque with a minaret stands behind smoke and a fire on the skyline. The sea is choppy under a stormy sky. The central sailor's cap band carries painted lettering. Fills the image edge to edge, with no frame and no gore.

treaty-of-fez-morocco.description: An ornate Moroccan room with a carved dark wood low table holding an unrolled cream parchment scroll, a brass inkwell with a quill, and a red wax seal. A black peaked cap with gold braid and brown leather gloves rest on the table, and an embroidered cushion sits on a bench behind it. Zellige tiles line the walls, carved wooden doors stand in the background, and the floor is patterned tile. No people are visible, and the scroll shows no legible writing. The style is an oil painting that fills the frame edge to edge.

rif-rout-spain-annual.description: A painted scene of a line of hooded and turbaned fighters in dark robes, carrying rifles, charging up a dry rocky slope through drifting smoke. A spoked-wheel field cannon sits at right beside canvas tents, sandbags and scattered rifles, under a dark stormy sky. There are no visible letters, frame or border, and nothing bloody.
